Thursday Afternoon Social Ride

Gladeville, TN · Road

Beginner friendly

Thursday Afternoon Social Ride is a road group ride in Gladeville, TN. It rolls every Thursday at 5:15 pm from Gladeville Community Center. Pace: 11–18+ mph, pick your route.

The club's full weekday calendar is April to September, with weekend rides in the off-season. This ride was still listed on Oct 1, 2026 at an earlier 5:15 start.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:15 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: 11–18+ mph, pick your route. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Thursday Afternoon Social Ride group ride

An evening ride with a short casual route for people getting back on the bike and a longer, faster one for stronger riders. Pick your own pace and distance. Routes are set to get everyone back before sunset. The club calls it a good ride for meeting members.
